description.value: Hopkins Harvest is a family-owned specialty market established in 1995 on Highway 93/95 in Windermere, combining a locally sourced produce and artisan goods market with the Hot Spot Bistro (wood-fired pizza, gourmet sandwiches, fresh-baked sourdough), a specialty coffee bar, and a seasonal ice cream truck. The market focuses on grower-direct and BC-sourced products including organic produce, wild-caught seafood, Okanagan fruit, and meat and dairy. It is a genuine multi-concept food stop in the heart of the Columbia Valley, well-positioned for touring cyclists on the busy Hwy 93/95 corridor.
